Part of me would have definitely liked to go, but the INWGF part of me said that my first sighting of a naked girl had to be of my girlfriend! Thankfully, the INWGF part of me won. In those far off days, pornography was far less accessible, and somehow I didn't buy any, even though I was INWGF for three and a half of my six years at university. I did not normally relieve myself more than about once a day.  BTW, always use Vaseline when masturbating, or you will desensitise it before the great day comes! Obviously the problem of being INWGF starts in school. Everyone suddenly goes through puberty, and while the physical changes take years to develop fully, the mental change - suddenly aching for a girlfriend - happened almost instantaneously - at least for me. I suspect that many boys of this age are rather shy with girls. However, they mix in school, in parties, on holiday, or whatever, and almost all normal boys end up with about three (say) teenage relationships - whether they actually have sex, is really not that important. Not all girls are super attractive, and some have acne at that age, so while normal men get a taste of a relationship while at school, they don't necessarily pair off with someone utterly beautiful. Nevertheless, they enjoy these relationships immensely, and remember them all their lives. They learn that girlfriends don't have to be instantly attractive to be great fun. They also discover that most people respect them for having a girl - they don't judge by how beautiful she is. However things didn't go too well, because she was very insecure, and X was having difficulties with an addiction to antidepressants, that messed up his libido.
